title: Henri III → Bellièvre and Villeroy, Ollainville: cipher postscript (17 lines) and three glossed cipher passages
correspondents: Henri III (countersigned Pinart) → Pomponne de Bellièvre and Nicolas de Neufville de Villeroy
folio_note: Gallica btv1b9064322t canvases 92-95 (openings). f. 521r 7 cipher lines and f. 521v 2 + 13 lines, each with the contemporary decipherment in the margin; f. 522v a 17-line cipher postscript after the signature, nothing written beside it
status: Found by the Bellièvre volume sweep, 5 Nov 2026 (research/gallica_sweep/NOTES.md). Homophonic letter substitution with word signs and number codes; key rebuilt from the glossed blocks and the postscript read in part (research/gallica_sweep/bellievre_hi/ps1580/report.md). Printed: Lettres de Henri III t. V (2000) no. 4006, p. 110, an analysis that quotes and summarises the postscript (Biron and the peace, Villeroy to write to him), so its content was deciphered by the editors. Closed as read (edition).
why: Henri III's instructions to his two negotiators on their way to the peace of Fleix: Anjou's troops near Cambrai, Portugal, England and Biron's part in the peace.
score_note: Viewed on the full-resolution Gallica images (openapi.bnf.fr IIIF) during the Bellièvre volume sweep, 5 Nov 2026
verify: Read p. 110 of Lettres de Henri III t. V to see whether the editors print more of the postscript than the analysis; the key here (ps1580/key.json) can read it in full and may read Godefroy 260 f. 52 (catalogue #1185).
